title: The Tourist Trap
start: Speak to Irena, the woman crying at the Shantay Pass, south of Al Kharid.

items.t: Desert shirt, desert robe, and desert boots (Black variants will not work. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
10 feathers (You can only use regular feathers. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
Bronze bar (The bar must be in your inventory.)
At least 200 coins (or 100 with ring of charos (a))

recommended.t: Protection from desert heat, at least 2-3 full waterskins, an enchanted water tiara, or completion of Crocodile Tears
Weapons and armour for lower combat level players
At least 15 backpack spaces - you will need to remove all worn items and still have room in your backpack for up to 7 quest items

rewards.t: 4,650 experience in your choice of two from the following skills (you may pick the same skill twice): Agility, Fletching, Smithing or Thieving
A wrought iron key for access to the Desert Mining Camp and the cave beneath it (can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour)

steps.t: If you don't have desert clothes, buy them from Shantay.

Begin the quest by talking to Irena (south of Shantay Pass). [Chat: 1 What's the matter? › 1 When did she go into the desert? › 3 I'll look for your daughter. › 1 Okay Irena, calm down. I'll get your daughter back for you. › Accept]
p: Speaking to Irena at the Shantay Pass.

steps.t: Run south and slightly west to the gate of the Desert Mining Camp.

Making sure not to attack him, talk to Mercenary Captain (the one with the all-grey shield). [Chat: 1 Wow! A real captain! › 2 I'd love to work for a tough guy like you! › 2 Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you? › 2 Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that. › 1 It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!]
Kill the Mercenary Captain to obtain a metal key.

sub.t: The metal key can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour.

steps.t: Unequip all armour (includes amulets, rings, etc.) and weapons, and keep them unequipped whenever inside the mining camp or mine.
Open the gate to enter the camp.

Go east to the mine door entrance and talk to the male slave on the east of the camp (it's the one who never mines). [Chat: 1 I've just arrived. › 2 Oh yes, that sounds interesting. › 1 What's that then? › 1 I can try to undo them for you. › 1 It's funny you should say that... › 1 Yeah, okay, let's give it a go. › 1 Yes, I'll trade.]

sub.t: If a guard catches you unlocking the slave's chains and you end up in the cell, bend the bars on the window and escape. Talk to the slave to try again.

p: Trading clothes with the Male slave.

steps.t: While wearing the slave outfit, open the mine door entrance. The outfit must be equipped any time you enter the mine.
Upon entering, head north and follow the cave around until you come to a guarded cave entrance.
Making sure not to attack him, talk to one of the guards. [Chat: 2 I'd like to mine in a different area. › 2 Yes sir, you're quite right sir. › 2 Yes sir, we understand each other perfectly.]
Head back to the mine doors and exit.
Unequip your slave clothing and leave the Desert Mining Camp through the gate.
Run west to the Bedabin Camp.
Talk to Al Shabim in the southernmost tent to receive the Bedabin key. [Chat: 1 I am looking for a pineapple. › 1 Yes, I'm interested.]
Run east back to the Desert Mining Camp and climb up the ladder in the white building.
On the western wall search the south-western bookcase for a book on sailing.

Talk to Captain Siad in the same room and ask him if you can chat with him, then mention the sailing book. [Chat: 1 I wanted to have a chat? › 5 You seem to have a lot of books! › 3 So, you're interested in sailing? › 1 I could tell by the cut of your jib.]
p: Making the prototype dart tip for Al Shabim.

steps.t: Open the chest beside the table to get the plans.
Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm very interested. › 1 Yes, I'm kind of curious.]
Enter the tent to the north.
Use the experimental anvil with a bronze bar in your inventory and answer the prompt [Chat: 1 Yes. I'd like to try.] to create a prototype dart tip.
Use a feather on the dart tip to make a prototype dart.
Take this back to Al Shabim. He will take the prototype dart, technical plans, and Bedabin key in exchange for a bronze dart and Tenti pineapple.
Wear the slave outfit, head back down into the mine and give the pineapple to one of the guards.
Walk through the mine cave and run east to the mine cart.
Choose "Search" option on one of the empty barrels nearby and answer the prompt [Chat: 1 Yeah, cool!] to take it.
Choose "Search" option on the mine cart to ride it to the other side, answering the prompt to confirm. [Chat: 1 Yes, of course.]

sub.t: Failing to enter the cart will cause minor damage. If you fail, attempt to enter the cart again.

steps.t: Go down the northwestern passageway containing a large number of slaves at the end and you will find Ana.
Use the barrel in your inventory on Ana to squeeze her inside it, and head back to the mine cart.
Use Ana on the mine cart first, then ride it yourself when it comes back. [Chat: 1 Yes, of course.]
Search the barrels around the cart and retrieve the one that has Ana in it.
Use the winch bucket north-west of the cart to put the barrel on it.
Accept the guard's offer for help and give him a compliment. [Chat: 1 Yes please. › 1 I said you were very gregarious!]
Head back to the surface and go to the winch bucket in the south-western corner of the camp.

sub.t: Do not remove your slave clothes at any point.

steps.t: Operate it and then search the barrel west of it.
Use Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the camp.

Talk to the Mine-cart driver. (Warning: If you use the wrong responses you'll have to rescue Ana again!) [Chat: 2 Nice cart. › 2 One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'. › 1 'One good turn deserves another' › 3 Fired... no, shot perhaps! › 3 In for a penny in for a pound. › 3 Well, you see, it's like this... › 1 Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here! › 2 You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!]

sub.t: If you fail, you need to head back into the deepest part of the mine with a barrel and get Ana out again.

p: Ana, in a barrel, in a mine cart.

steps.t: Search the cart and answer the prompt [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll get on.] to get on.
Run north-east towards Shantay Pass and talk to Irena.
Congratulations, quest complete!
